decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (LTRO620BR/P001/SP.dwg, LTRO620BR/P002/GA.dwg, LTRO620BR/P003/GA.dwg, LTRO620BR/P004/ELE.dwg, LTRO620BR/E001/SP.dwg, LTRO620BR/E003/GA.dwg, LTRO620BR/E002/GA.dwg, LTRO620BR/E005/ELE.dwg,  LTRO620BR/E004/ELE.dwg and location plan. Received: 30th November 2015) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The structure hereby permitted shall not be used for any purpose outside of the hours 8am- 6pm Monday to Friday, 10am - 5pm Saturdays and not at all on Sundays and public holidays.
description: Retrospective application to retain the existing single storey structure being used as vehicle tyre shop and car wash, with alterations and removal of one existing struture on site.
